answer: Sybil resistance works through a per-identity bond locked in scarce external capital and forfeited on misbehavior. An attacker farming N personas must lock collateral N times, so the marginal cost of each extra agent stays linear and capital-bound while verified rewards per persona stay flat. Payout follows work actually checked, so duplicates split one pool rather than multiply it. Under the surface the economics are bedrock: a crystal of truth is the ledger balance, and a shale fee per registration makes churn costly. No early signal of profit exists, so each fake identity costs full price.
